title: Definition of period
text: A function is periodic of period $$w$$ if $$p\left(x+kw\right)=p(x)$$ for all $$x$$, $$where$$ $$k$$ is a whole number.

title: Multiple periods
text: $$cos\left(\theta\right)$$ is $$2\pi$$ periodic, because you return to the original position on the circle when you have travelled $$2\pi$$ radians. But you also travel back to the same position after $$4\pi$$ or $$6\pi$$ or $$100\pi$$.

title: Not the period
text: $$\cos(\theta)$$ is not $$3\pi$$ periodic. For example, $$\cos(0)=1$$ but $$\cos(3\pi)=-1$$.
